summary: MSVC CRT SEH helper that performs a global unwind: calls RtlUnwind(TargetFrame, &loc_58887C, 0, 0), passing the caller-supplied target frame, the local return-address label loc_58887C as the unwinding handler position, and null exception/context records. Used by ScriptFrameProcessor (0x0058895C) and LongjmpMSVCCRT (0x0058A770).

operations.description: Call RtlUnwind with the caller-supplied TargetFrame, the local label loc_58887C as the exception-handler return address, and null exception and context records, performing the global unwind pass of the enclosing SEH frame.
Return after RtlUnwind completes; the routine has no post-unwind code.

unresolved: The exact SEH frame state that makes loc_58887C the unwind return target is CRT-internal and not evidenced in the raw text.
Whether TargetFrame is always a valid frame and how callers ensure that is not evidenced here.
